title: From maintenance filter: count and total of every matching work order
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Maintenance Reminders QA build as an Owner/Admin (any user who can open Settings > Maintenance and create and edit work orders and customers).
  2. Open Settings > Maintenance. Open the schedule 'ZZAUTOTEST Highway Tractor PM', or create it with New schedule: add service 'PM-A' with a Calendar trigger of Every 6 months and canned lines, for example 'Engine oil and filter change' 0.8 hours, 'Chassis lubrication, 12 points' 0.5 hours, 'Air filter inspection' 0.3 hours and 'Brake adjustment check' 1.2 hours (4 lines, 2.8 hours). Save.
  3. Enroll units 'ZZAUTOTEST 402' and 'ZZAUTOTEST 403' so PM-A reads Overdue on both.
  4. Create work order X from the worklist (Create work order on 402's PM-A row) and add one extra hand-typed line to it (for example 1 hour of labour). Note X's Total.
  5. Create work order Y for 403 by hand and press Add Service > Add on PM-A. Note Y's Total.
  6. Create work order Z for 403 by hand with one hand-typed line and no service. Note it.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, search for 'ZZAUTOTEST Fleet Co' and turn on the From maintenance filter.
  2. Read the line above the list.
  3. Work out by hand: the count of X and Y, and X's Total plus Y's Total.
  4. Clear the search, keep From maintenance on, and read the line. Scroll down until more pages load, and read it again.
  5. Hover the (i) beside the Maintenance schedule column heading and read it.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • With both filters on, the line reads 2 work orders · $<X + Y> · Work order total; for example with X $1,050.40 and Y $620.00 it reads 2 work orders · $1,670.40 · Work order total.
  • Z, with no maintenance origin, is not counted.
  • The total uses each work order's whole total, including the hand-typed line on X, not only the lines PM-A added.
  • With only From maintenance on, the count and the total cover every matching work order across all pages: they do not change as more pages load.
  • The (i) explains the column (in the design: “Origin and value are reportable together, which is how a shop answers whether the feature earned anything.”).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10577 (S22, Origin reporting); Chunk 2 MR (Confluence 897679389) as edited 5 October 2026, S22; Design MR_V2_2 (Claude Design export, 6 Oct 2026), driven in full on 6 Oct 2026, Chunk 2 board artboard W14; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S22-R4: “The Work Orders list gains a From maintenance filter. With it applied, a line above the list reads the count and the total of every matching work order across all pages, for example 42 work orders · $38,410 · Work order total. The total is each work order's own total, not only the lines a service added. An organization-wide revenue report follows later”
  • S22-E2: “Without this column there is no way to answer whether the feature earned anything, which is why it is v1 rather than later”
  • Design, Chunk 2 board, artboard W14, (i) on the Maintenance Schedule column: “Origin and value are reportable together, which is how a shop answers whether the feature earned anything.”
